e.title: Insurance Support Agent
e.summary: 保险客服多智能体（LangGraph + Claude）：主管路由→保单/账单/理赔/通用专家+人工升级
e.body: Insurance Support Agent（kumarthiagarajan）是 LangGraph + Claude 构建的多智能体保险客服系统：Supervisor 把查询路由到 Policy/Billing/Claims/General Help 专家，SQLite/ChromaDB 支撑知识检索，必要时升级人工。对 RIAA：保险客服智能体的端到端参考架构——主管-专家模式（同 [[payer-agent-audit]] 的多智能体审计、[[claims-intake-agent]] 的理赔受理谱系）；对「多智能体编排 + 工具调用 + 人工升级」的可运行样例，课程项目直接可改；与 [[finance-llms]] 的领域 LLM 生态衔接。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：README 确认（Supervisor 路由 + 专家智能体 + SQLite/ChromaDB），未实测
e.summary_en: Multi-agent insurance customer support (LangGraph + Claude): supervisor routes to policy/billing/claims/general specialists + human escalation
e.summary_hk: 保險客服多智能體（LangGraph + Claude）：主管路由→保單/賬單/理賠/通用專家+人工升級
e.body_en: Insurance Support Agent (kumarthiagarajan) is a multi-agent insurance customer-support system built with LangGraph and Claude: a Supervisor routes queries to Policy/Billing/Claims/General Help specialists, backed by SQLite/ChromaDB for retrieval, escalating to a human when needed. For RIAA: an end-to-end reference architecture for insurance-support agents — the supervisor-specialist pattern (sharing the multi-agent lineage of [[payer-agent-audit]] and the claims-intake family [[claims-intake-agent]]); a runnable example of multi-agent orchestration + tool calling + human escalation that course projects can adapt directly; connects to the domain-LLM ecosystem of [[finance-llms]].
e.body_hk: Insurance Support Agent（kumarthiagarajan）是 LangGraph + Claude 構建的多智能體保險客服系統：Supervisor 把查詢路由到 Policy/Billing/Claims/General Help 專家，SQLite/ChromaDB 支撐知識檢索，必要時升級人工。對 RIAA：保險客服智能體的端到端參考架構——主管-專家模式（同 [[payer-agent-audit]] 的多智能體審計、[[claims-intake-agent]] 的理賠受理譜系）；對「多智能體編排 + 工具調用 + 人工升級」的可運行樣例，課程項目直接可改；與 [[finance-llms]] 的領域 LLM 生態銜接。
